Strategy: Conditional half-gap preservation. For large items, rank like Best Fit; for smaller items, prefer bins that still leave at least half the item size after placement, choosing the tightest among them, while bins leaving less score far lower. The choice differs from Best Fit for smaller items when the tightest fit would leave too little room. It may help by keeping bins usable for medium items, but may fail if the preserved half-gaps are never used.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) if item * 2 > max(bins) else (1000.0 - (r - item) if r - item >= item / 2 else -(r - item) - 500.0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Conditional half-gap preservation: large items Best Fit; smaller items prefer bins leaving >= item/2, tightest first.
